column1: # Units. Edit freely - the game reads this file on every start.
# class      : infantry | vehicle   (infantry must have armour 0 and can capture buildings)
# will       : willpower. At 0 the unit cannot move in its next turn; it is restored after that turn
# armour     : 0 = unarmoured (see damage formulas in README.md)
# move       : Bewegung - movement points per turn (terrain costs apply)
# vision     : Sicht - fog of war: how many tiles (Manhattan distance) the unit can see
# fuel       : vehicles only: max fuel. One fuel is used per turn in which the unit moves; at 0 it cannot move.
#              Refilled by a truck (refuel/supply weapon). 0 = no fuel system (infantry
# attributes : separated by | ; known: radio | double_attack | camouflage | heilung(N)
#              heilung(10) = the unit heals itself for 10 HP at the start of each of its turns

column2: default <id>.png; a fallback is drawn if missing)

column1: # attacks    : attacks per turn (default 1; the attribute double_attack makes it at least 2)
# ammo1-5    : optional per-unit override of the ammo of weapon1-5 (default = ammo column in weapons.csv)
